abbrev scalarRun (T t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.iterate BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (schedule (1/2))
    (fun s z => (payoff T (1 : ℝ) s z : EReal)) 0 t
abbrev scalarRegret (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (schedule (1/2))
    (fun s z => (payoff T (1 : ℝ) s z : EReal)) 0 0 T
abbrev direction : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := PiLp.single 2 0 1
abbrev vectorRun (T t : ℕ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
  BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.iterate BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (schedule (1/2))
    (fun s z => (payoff T direction s z : EReal)) 0 t
abbrev vectorRegret (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (schedule (1/2))
    (fun s z => (payoff T direction s z : EReal)) 0 0 T

supplied_typed_targets.header:
theorem check1 :
    schedule (1/2) 0 = 1 ∧
    0 < schedule (1/2) 1 ∧
    schedule (1/2) 1 < schedule (1/2) 0 ∧
    scalarRun 2 0 = 0 ∧ scalarRun 2 1 = 1 ∧
    scalarRun 2 2 = 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1/2 : ℝ)) ∧
    scalarRegret 2 = 1

theorem check2 :
    ‖direction‖ = 1 ∧ vectorRun 64 1 = direction ∧
    (∀ t < 64, ConvexOn ℝ univ (payoff 64 direction t) ∧
      LipschitzWith 1 (payoff 64 direction t)) ∧
    (1/15 : ℝ) ≤ coefficient (1/2) ∧
    2 / ((1 - (1/2 : ℝ)) * coefficient (1/2)) ≤ (64 : ℝ) ∧
    (1/2 : ℝ) * coefficient (1/2) * (64 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (1/2 : ℝ)) ≤ vectorRegret 64 ∧
    (256/15 : ℝ) ≤ vectorRegret 64 ∧ (17 : ℝ) < vectorRegret 64 ∧
    (∃ loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ,
      (∀ t < 64, ConvexOn ℝ univ (loss t) ∧ LipschitzWith 1 (loss t)) ∧
      (1/2 : ℝ) * coefficient (1/2) * (64 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (1/2 : ℝ)) ≤
        BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace
          (schedule (1/2)) (fun t z => (loss t z : EReal)) 0 0 64)

alias_reconstruction.scalarRun: x^T_0=0; x^T_{s+1}=x^T_s-eta(s)*sigma_T(s), where sigma_T(s)=-1 for s<ceil(T/2) and +1 otherwise. scalarRun(T,t)=x^T_t.
alias_reconstruction.scalarRegret: scalarRegret(T)=sum_{s=0}^{T-1} sigma_T(s)*x^T_s, since comparator 0 has loss 0.
alias_reconstruction.direction: d=PiLp.single 2 0 1 in EuclideanSpace R (Fin 2); standard coordinate reading (1,0). Its unit norm is explicitly included in check2.
alias_reconstruction.vectorRegret: vectorRegret(T)=sum_{s=0}^{T-1} sigma_T(s)*<d,X^T_s>, versus the zero vector comparator.

stream_identity.conclusion: The two checks instantiate the same parameterized construction at different horizons and in different spaces; they do not share one fixed loss sequence.
stream_identity.T2: m=ceil(2/2)=1: scalar loss is -z at s=0 and +z at every s>=1. Its tested horizon scores s=0,1.
stream_identity.T64: m=ceil(64/2)=32: vector loss is -<d,z> at s=0,...,31 and +<d,z> at every s>=32. Its tested horizon scores s=0,...,63.
stream_identity.explicit_difference: At s=1, the T=2 scalar stream has positive sign whereas the T=64 vector stream has negative sign. Even under the natural identification z=r*d, these losses are opposite for nonzero r. The definitions therefore cannot be read as one common horizon-independent sequence.
stream_identity.witness_scope: The last conjunct of check2 introduces its own existentially quantified vector-valued-domain loss sequence. No identity with another named or existential sequence is imposed; the named T64 payoff stream satisfies the requested properties if the other stated conjuncts hold.
